title: A reminder in your own words
description: A voice reminder speaks the task. You can test the alert in advance and choose when to repeat it.

blocks.text: The phone gave an alert, but the person could not recall what they set it for. What they need is a short wording of the action at the moment of the reminder.

quote.text: I have so many notifications on my phone that I end up tuning them all out. That’s bad when you forget almost everything without something reminding you. This allows me to yell at myself from my own phone about what specifically I need to do.

blocks.text: Record your own phrase or choose to have the text spoken. Set the time of the event and the time to get ready for it separately. Play a test alert during setup; after a snooze, show when it will come back.

Test on an ordinary household errand that the message is clear without opening the calendar and does not reveal anything private in front of other people. A choice of silent mode has to be respected. A voice reminder remains a way of stating the task, not a guarantee that it will be done.
